items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: I won't say better, but way ahead, advanced. 'Cause I swear, I'm always thinkin' advanced. I always listened to things, the things that knocked me out was the ones that was more advanced all the time.

ctx.x: Yeah, I liked, at that time I enjoyed the Elk [?], very much those bands for their musical ability. But I tell you, I was still advanced, you know, I was still thinkin' advanced. Now of all those bands that I heard, the band, white band that knocked me out the most was Jean Goldkette's Band. And as you all know Jean Goldkette's Band was way ahead of bands like Benson, if you listen to the records. I won't say better, but way ahead, advanced. 'Cause I swear, I'm always thinkin' advanced.
